characters.name: ORAV KUSTI
characters.description: Väike oranž orav koheva sabaga, seljas heleroheline pikkade varrukatega kootud kampsun (light green knitted sweater, not a collar). Temal on suured pruunid silmad ja rõõmus näoilme. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: HIIR MIINA
characters.description: Väike hall hiir suurte ümarate kõrvadega, kandmas kollast salli ja punaseid pükse. Sõbralik ja uudishimulik ilme. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Sügisene aed
locations.description: Sunny autumn garden with large maple trees showing bright yellow, orange, and red leaves. Green lawn sprinkled with fallen leaves. A simple dark wooden bench is visible near the back trees. Clear soft blue autumn sky, warm bright lighting, cozy atmosphere. Cartoon children's book style.

pages.text: ORAV KUSTI JA HIIR MIINA ON AIAS.
pages.scene: Orav Kusti (orange squirrel in green sweater) and Hiir Miina (grey mouse in yellow scarf and red pants) stand together in the middle of a sunny autumn garden. They are smiling and looking around at the colorful trees. Kusti is an orange squirrel in a light green knitted long-sleeved sweater. Miina is a small grey mouse in a yellow scarf and red pants. The picture fills the whole frame, no band or stripe at the bottom.

Orav Kusti and Hiir Miina stand in the garden looking up in delight as bright yellow and orange leaves gently float down from the trees. Kusti is an orange squirrel in a light green knitted long-sleeved sweater. Miina is a small grey mouse in a yellow scarf and red pants. The picture fills the whole frame, no band or stripe at the bottom.

Orav Kusti walks happily across the garden grass carrying a small green toy rake. Hiir Miina stands nearby watching him with interest. Kusti is an orange squirrel in a light green knitted long-sleeved sweater. Miina is a small grey mouse in a yellow scarf and red pants. The picture fills the whole frame, no band or stripe at the bottom.

Hiir Miina kneels on the grass, gathering bright red autumn leaves with her hands into a pile. Orav Kusti stands beside her raking more leaves towards her with his green toy rake. Kusti is an orange squirrel in a light green knitted long-sleeved sweater. Miina is a small grey mouse in a yellow scarf and red pants. The picture fills the whole frame, no band or stripe at the bottom.

Orav Kusti and Hiir Miina stand proudly next to a large, tall pile of gathered red, yellow, and orange autumn leaves on the green grass. Kusti is an orange squirrel in a light green knitted long-sleeved sweater. Miina is a small grey mouse in a yellow scarf and red pants. The picture fills the whole frame, no band or stripe at the bottom.

Orav Kusti leaps excitedly through the air, diving right into the middle of the big colorful leaf pile. Hiir Miina watches him happily with arms outstretched. Kusti is an orange squirrel in a light green knitted long-sleeved sweater. Miina is a small grey mouse in a yellow scarf and red pants. The picture fills the whole frame down to the grass at the bottom edge, no yellow band or stripe at the bottom.

A small grey mouse with big round ears, a yellow scarf and red pants (Hiir Miina) is in the air above the leaf pile, arms spread wide, jumping happily down into the big leaf pile. Below her, the orange squirrel (Orav Kusti) sits deep in the leaf pile, only his head, arms and bushy tail showing, with leaves on his head, laughing and looking up at the mouse. The squirrel is NOT jumping on this page; only the mouse is in the air. Leaves fly up around them. Kusti is an orange squirrel with a bushy tail and squirrel ear tufts in a light green knitted long-sleeved sweater. The picture fills the whole frame, no band or stripe at the bottom.

Orav Kusti and Hiir Miina sit side by side inside the scattered leaf pile, resting happily with leaves on their heads, laughing together under the bright autumn sky. Kusti is an orange squirrel in a light green knitted long-sleeved sweater. Miina is a small grey mouse in a yellow scarf and red pants. The picture fills the whole frame, no band or stripe at the bottom.
